panels.description:
**O que mede:** conclusao macro sobre a capacidade de cada fila continuar avancando. O valor 0 significa Saudavel, 1 Degradada, 2 Doente e 3 Sem diagnostico.

**Como interpretar:** comece sempre aqui. Fila doente significa problema coletivo de progressao, como backlog sem vazao ou ausencia de evidencia recente. Uma fila saudavel ainda pode conter itens individualmente doentes; isso aparece no painel seguinte.

**Proxima acao:** se a fila estiver doente, investigue Worker, banco, dependencia e capacidade antes de abrir itens individuais.

targets.expr: max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ((3 * (max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="sample_failed", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}) > bool 0)) or (3 * ((time() - max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="sampled_at_unix_seconds", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"})) > bool 180)) or (2 * (max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="eligible_backlog", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}) > bool 0) * on (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation) group_left() (sum by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation) (increase({__name__=~"yeshua_worker_items(_item)?(_total)?", state="processed", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service"}[5m])) == bool 0) * on (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) (max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="oldest_eligible_age_seconds", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}) >= bool 120)) or (0 * (max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="sampled_at_unix_seconds", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}) >= bool 0)))

panels.title: 1. A fila esta saudavel?

panels.description:
**O que mede:** conclusao separada sobre os itens de cada fila. O valor 0 significa Sem doentes, 1 Com atencao e 2 Com doenca critica.

**Como interpretar:** este painel nao declara a fila inteira doente. Ele informa que existem individuos que exigem investigacao mesmo quando outros itens continuam avancando normalmente. Falha terminal e processamento abandonado sao tratados como criticos.

**Proxima acao:** abra a composicao das doencas e depois consulte apenas os itens da categoria escolhida.

targets.expr: max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ((2 * (max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric=~"sick_item_(terminal_failure|stale_processing)", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}) > bool 0)) or (1 * (max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="sick_items", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}) > bool 0)) or (0 * (max by (deployment_environment_name, service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="sampled_at_unix_seconds", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}) >= bool 0)))

panels.title: 2. Existem itens doentes?

panels.description:
**O que mede:** quantidade atual de itens doentes em todas as filas selecionadas.

**Como interpretar:** zero significa que nenhum item foi classificado como doente no ultimo snapshot. Um valor positivo deve ser aberto por tipo no painel de composicao; ele nao deve ser confundido com backlog.

**Proxima acao:** use o tipo de doenca para decidir quais itens merecem correlacao com evidencias e traces.

targets.expr: sum(max by (service_name, operation, queue) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric="sick_items", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}))

panels.title: 3. Total de itens doentes

panels.description:
**O que mede:** distribui os itens doentes entre espera excessiva, processamento abandonado, execucao recorrente, falha repetida e falha terminal.

**Como interpretar:** as categorias sao mutuamente exclusivas e priorizam a doenca mais grave. A categoria descreve o sintoma operacional, nao prova a causa raiz. Exception, SQL lento, dependencia, capacidade e regra de negocio so podem ser afirmados depois da evidencia.

**Proxima acao:** escolha a categoria dominante e abra as evidencias individuais abaixo.

targets.expr: sum by (metric) (max by (service_name, operation, queue, metric) ({__name__=~"yeshua_queue_current(_value)?", metric=~"sick_item_(excessive_wait|stale_processing|recurrent_execution|repeated_failure|terminal_failure)", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_name=~"$service", queue=~"$queue"}))

panels.title: 4. Qual e a doenca?

panels.description:
**O que mede:** evidencias individuais sanitizadas publicadas quando um item adoece ou muda de estado. O painel cobre os cinco dias de retencao dos logs, independentemente da janela escolhida no restante do dashboard.

**Como interpretar:** cada linha mostra tenant, fila, tipo, referencia, doenca, severidade, retries e identidade causal. Evidencias repetidas do mesmo item representam mudancas observadas em momentos diferentes.

**Navegacao:** clique em `ItemReference` e escolha **Abrir detalhe deste item** para ver seu historico e chegar ao trace da tentativa.

targets.expr: {service_name=~".+"} | service_name=~"$service" |= "QueueItem.HealthChanged" |~ "$queue" | json environment="Environment", tenant_id="Data.TenantId", queue_name="Data.Queue", item_type="Data.ItemType", item_reference="Data.ItemReference", disease="Data.Disease", severity="Data.Severity", retry_count="Data.RetryCount", root_operation_id="Data.RootOperationId", error_signature="Data.ErrorSignature" | environment=~"$environment" | line_format "{{.tenant_id}}|{{.queue_name}}|{{.item_type}}|{{.item_reference}}|{{.disease}}|{{.severity}}|{{.retry_count}}|{{.root_operation_id}}|{{.error_signature}}"

panels.title: 5. Quais itens estao doentes? Clique no ItemReference para investigar
